messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding hf/oxford-12b via our HF->Redwood chat_template converter. Seeing assistant role markers get collapsed when the assistant message is empty, which causes KV-cache alignment issues during streaming and a quality regression after 4-bit quantization. Repro and snippets below.

maria: original jinja template we used:
```jinja
{% for m in messages %}
{% if m.role == 'system' %}
{{ m.content }}
{% else %}
<|{{ m.role }}|>
{{ m.content }}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
```

maria: rendered output for a sequence with an empty assistant turn (notice missing assistant sentinel):
```
system: You are a helpful assistant.
<|user|>
Hello
<|assistant|>

<|user|>
Follow up
```

maria: ^ the second <|assistant|> marker vanished (empty content rendered as empty line), so downstream runtime concatenates 2 user turns in the same session fragment -> kv-cache offset mismatch.

sam: Do you have logs showing kv cache complaints?

maria: pasted snippet from runtime log after reproducing: 
```
2023-11-02T12:23:45Z WARN kv_cache: expected_start=1024 actual_start=1020 (misaligned)
2023-11-02T12:23:45Z INFO stream: fallback_to_sync=true cache_miss=1
```

ashley: This rings a bell — our HF converter strips blank blocks (`trim` or `strip` in the template) which collapses the sentinel. Jinja will drop whitespace unless we explicitly render a placeholder.

jordan: Quick patch idea: ensure assistant sentinel always present even if content empty, e.g. in template use `{{ m.content | default(" ") }}` or conditional that inserts a nonbreaking space. Proposed snippet:
```jinja
<|{{ m.role }}|>{{ m.content | default(' ') }}
```

maria: Tried that locally. Re-ran the 4-bit quantized evaluation on our convo-long benchmark (n=1.2k dialogs):
- fp16 baseline: Rouge-L = 0.685
- 4-bit before fix: Rouge-L = 0.622 (regression)
- 4-bit after fix: Rouge-L = 0.672 (most of regression recovered)

katy: Nice. Can you add a tiny unit/regression test in hf->redwood converter to catch empty-role sentinel loss? Also add a comment why we need the placeholder (kv-cache alignment).

maria: Yep — will add a test that renders sequences with consecutive empty assistant/user combos and asserts sentinel counts and positions. I'll also add a short note in the converter docs.

sam: Also check config.json conversion: some models set `add_bos`/`sep_token` behavior differently; we should make the converter emit an explicit `assistant_sentinel` token in model-specific overrides so tokenizers don't collapse it during normalization.

jordan: Filed a tiny follow-up: we should run a quick smoke on Dedicated runtime for streaming to ensure we didn't mask any latency regressions when we preserved placeholders. I'll queue a canary after the patch.

ashley: FYI eval-bot just posted the automated run summary for the after-fix eval: 
`eval-bot: hf/oxford-12b quant4-run: throughput=18.2 req/s, avg_latency=210ms, rouge-l=0.672, ci95=±0.007`

maria: Assigning: I'll push the converter patch + unit test (PR later today). jordan will run Dedicated canary. sam will add the tokenizer override checklist to the model onboarding playbook. katy please add a short blurb to the eval checklist about sentinel-counting tests.

katy: ack :+1:

eval-bot: note: adding sentinel-count test may be useful upstream in hf/chat-template reference too.

maria: thanks all — will link PR here when ready.
